page.overview:
Who is Misty?

Misty is a character making her debut in Generation I. Misty is the Gym Leader of the Cerulean City Gym and specializes in -type Pokémon, and therefore the second in Kanto. She gives the Cascade Badge to trainers that defeat her. Misty also goes by the title The Tomboyish Mermaid.

Misty is a slender girl with spiky scarlet hair and the muscular build of a professional swimmer. Unlike most other characters, her appearance has a tendency to fluctuate; she appears significantly older in later games than in earlier ones, specifically in Generations II and IV.

Misty has short orange hair tied into a pigtail on the left side of her head with a blue hair tie, spikier hair on the right side, and light skin. She wears a strapless two-piece blue swimsuit (with the bottoms being shorts) that leaves her arms, legs, midriffs, and belly button bare. A pair of sandals completes the outfit. She also wears black wristbands.

Similarly to Brock in-game, Misty's appearance is redesigned to closely appear how she looks in the anime, wearing a shirt, shoes, and having a different battle pose holding a Poké Ball.
